title: No account deletion or data-erasure capability anywhere in the stack
remediation: Design an account-deletion saga (auth-service originates a UserDeletionRequested event; each service erases/anonymizes its slice; media purges MinIO objects), plus a documented manual runbook as interim.

title: Uncommitted landing/waitlist rework failed its own unit test at audit snapshot (fixed later the same day, still uncommitted)
remediation: Commit the fix, re-run the FULL web suite green, and rebuild parkio-hostinger-landing.zip from the fixed tree before deploying; verify one live submit against a running gateway.

title: Single-node data plane: no HA Postgres/PITR, single Kafka broker, single MinIO
remediation: For beta: enforce backup schedule + weekly restore drill on the real host, monitor disk. For production: execute the managed-services migration already planned in production-readiness.md.

title: No open-source license selected; repository is source-visible only
remediation: Maintainer/legal decision: pick a license, replace LICENSE, add NOTICE if required, update README/SECURITY/release docs. Not chosen by this audit per instructions.

title: Edge rate limiting likely fails open when Redis is down (framework default)
remediation: Verify behavior with Redis stopped (chaos test exists in repo scaffolding); add an Alertmanager rule on Redis down; consider a deny-fallback for /auth/** routes.

title: Redis is an availability single point of failure for login and waitlist
remediation: Document the posture; alert on Redis health; consider bounded in-memory fallback only if the posture decision calls for it.

title: Per-user location behavior logs grow forever (search + view logs, no retention)
remediation: Add a retention window (e.g. 90 days) to the existing RetentionCleanupJob pattern, or aggregate to daily counts and drop raw rows; document it on the privacy page.

title: Legal privacy/terms pages are explicit placeholders; waitlist has no deletion/retention procedure
remediation: Have counsel (or founder with template review) finalize beta-scope privacy/terms; add a waitlist-removal runbook or admin endpoint; define waitlist retention.

title: Mobile device runtime smoke never executed for the release line; store-readiness blockers open
remediation: Execute docs/beta/mobile-release.md smoke on a physical device and record evidence; close listing blockers.

title: GitHub Actions are tag-pinned, not commit-SHA-pinned
remediation: Pin every third-party action to a full commit SHA (Dependabot keeps them fresh); one PR.

title: Ten-service microservice topology is heavy for a pre-user product
remediation: No action now (repo already documents consolidation candidates); revisit after beta metrics.

title: Infrastructure plumbing is copy-pasted across all services by design; drift risk
remediation: Move service-agnostic plumbing (relay skeleton, retention job, gateway-auth filter) into platform module while keeping event payloads/domain service-owned.

title: All Docker-dependent verification was BLOCKED in this audit environment
remediation: Re-run the blocked commands on a Docker-capable host and attach results to the test-evidence doc.

title: Write-path performance is unmeasured; read path has real evidence
remediation: Extend the k6 harness with an upload/spot-create scenario against a disposable stack; measure ClamAV throughput.

title: Alert delivery, uptime monitoring and on-call are operator-TODO; alerts route to null by default
remediation: Set PARKIO_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL at deploy (preflight could enforce non-empty for hosted-beta), add a free external uptime monitor for the three domains.

title: Developer machine npm configuration disables TLS to the package registry
remediation: Delete the registry/strict-ssl lines from ~/.npmrc (defaults are HTTPS + strict TLS).

title: Alertmanager placeholder receiver ships by default (see OPS-001) and infra/ IaC is a stub
remediation: Defer until AWS phase; then Terraform the VPC/RDS/ECS skeleton.

title: Local dev docker/.env holds a real RSA private key in plaintext (gitignored, untracked)
remediation: Keep dev keys clearly labeled, never reuse in hosted envs (already documented); optionally move hosted-beta secrets to an encrypted store on the VPS.

title: Container base images are tag-pinned, not digest-pinned
remediation: Pin FROM lines to sha256 digests; let Dependabot/Renovate bump them.

title: One moderate npm advisory: transitive uuid <11.1.1 via Expo xcode tooling
remediation: Track Expo SDK updates; add a pnpm audit gate to frontend CI if desired.

title: Notification NEARBY_PARKING fan-out is a TODO (documented accepted risk AR-01)
remediation: Implement geo-fanout (parking event -> user-service nearby query -> notification), respecting privacy minimization.

title: Analytics snapshot reads are unbounded findAll() (slow-growing tables)
remediation: Add date-range parameters (already natural for snapshots).

title: No database CHECK constraints on latitude/longitude ranges
remediation: Add CHECK (latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90) and (longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180) in a new migration.

title: Five ESLint warnings in the web app (react-refresh export patterns)
remediation: Split mixed component/constant exports or accept and silence with rationale.

title: KNOWN-ISSUES OP-06 ('backup restore not automated in CI') is stale — a weekly CI restore drill exists
remediation: Doc fix.

title: Waitlist HMAC hash secret defaults to reusing the gateway internal secret
remediation: Require PARKIO_WAITLIST_HASH_SECRET explicitly in hosted profiles (preflight check).

title: One flaky mobile test under slow I/O (SmartReturnScreen search flow)
remediation: Raise the specific waitFor/test timeout or await the debounce deterministically (fake timers).

title: Verified security strengths (recorded for due diligence)
remediation: None — maintain.

title: Documentation maturity claims are calibrated and evidence-backed (verified strength)
remediation: None — maintain.
